dPersonnel.04.definition: The Street or PO Box of the personnel's mailing address.

dPersonnel.05.name: EMS Personnel's City of Residence
dPersonnel.05.definition: The city of the personnel's mailing address.

dPersonnel.06.name: EMS Personnel's State
dPersonnel.06.definition: The state of the personnel's mailing address.

dPersonnel.07.name: EMS Personnel's ZIP Code
dPersonnel.07.definition: The ZIP code of the personnel's mailing address.

dPersonnel.08.name: EMS Personnel's Country
dPersonnel.08.definition: The country of the personnel mailing address.

dPersonnel.09.name: EMS Personnel's Phone Number
dPersonnel.09.definition: The phone number for the personnel.

dPersonnel.10.name: EMS Personnel's Email Address
dPersonnel.10.definition: The primary email address of the personnel.

dPersonnel.13.name: EMS Personnel's Race
dPersonnel.13.definition: The personnel's race as defined by the OMB (US Office of Management and Budget).

dPersonnel.14.name: EMS Personnel's Citizenship
dPersonnel.14.definition: The documentation of the personnel's citizenship.

dPersonnel.15.name: EMS Personnel's Highest Educational Degree
dPersonnel.15.definition: The highest educational degree completed by the personnel.

dPersonnel.16.name: EMS Personnel's Degree Subject/Field of Study
dPersonnel.16.definition: The area of the personnel's post high-school (post-secondary) degree.

dPersonnel.17.name: EMS Personnel's Motor Vehicle License Type
dPersonnel.17.definition: The type of motor vehicle license (i.e. Class A, B, Pilot, etc.) of the EMS personnel.

dPersonnel.19.name: EMS Personnel's Immunization Year
dPersonnel.19.definition: The year associated with each immunization type.

dPersonnel.20.name: EMS Personnel's Foreign Language Ability
dPersonnel.20.definition: The languages spoken (other than English) by the personnel with at least an elementary level of proficiency.

dPersonnel.21.name: EMS Personnel's Agency ID Number
dPersonnel.21.definition: The local agency ID number for the personnel.

dPersonnel.22.name: EMS Personnel's State of Licensure
dPersonnel.22.definition: The state of the certification/licensure ID number assigned to the personnel member.

dPersonnel.23.name: EMS Personnel's State's Licensure ID Number
dPersonnel.23.definition: The state's licensure/certification ID number for the personnel.

dPersonnel.24.name: EMS Personnel's State EMS Certification Licensure Level
dPersonnel.24.definition: The personnel's state EMS certification level.

dPersonnel.25.name: EMS Personnel's State EMS Current Certification Date
dPersonnel.25.definition: The date of the personnel's current EMS certification/licensure.

dPersonnel.26.name: EMS Personnel's Initial State's Licensure Issue Date
dPersonnel.26.definition: The date on which the EMS personnel's state's EMS certification/licensure was originally issued. This is the date of the first certification/licensure for the EMS level.

dPersonnel.27.name: EMS Personnel's Current State's Licensure Expiration Date
dPersonnel.27.definition: The date on which the EMS personnel's (highest) state EMS certification/licensure expires.

dPersonnel.28.name: EMS Personnel's National Registry Number
dPersonnel.28.definition: The National Registry number associated with the level of certification/licensure obtained through NREMT.

dPersonnel.29.name: EMS Personnel's National Registry Certification Level
dPersonnel.29.definition: The level of the current National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT) certification.

dPersonnel.30.name: EMS Personnel's Current National Registry Expiration Date
dPersonnel.30.definition: The date on which the EMS Personnel's National Registry of EMTs certification/licensure expires.

dPersonnel.31.name: EMS Personnel's Employment Status
dPersonnel.31.definition: The personnel's primary employment status for this agency.

dPersonnel.33.name: EMS Personnel's Hire Date
dPersonnel.33.definition: The date the employee was hired by the EMS agency for this current job.

dPersonnel.34.name: EMS Personnel's Primary EMS Job Role
dPersonnel.34.definition: The individuals primary/main EMS role at the EMS agency. This is the function which is performed the majority of the time for the EMS personnel.

dPersonnel.35.name: EMS Personnel's Other Job Responsibilities
dPersonnel.35.definition: The EMS personnel's other job responsibilities at the agency beyond their primary role documented in dPersonnel.34 (EMS Personnel's Primary EMS Job Role).

dPersonnel.36.name: EMS Personnel's Total Length of Service in Years
dPersonnel.36.definition: The personnel's total length of EMS service at any level (years).

dPersonnel.37.name: EMS Personnel's Date Length of Service Documented
dPersonnel.37.definition: The date which the length of EMS service was documented.

dPersonnel.38.name: EMS Personnel's Practice Level
dPersonnel.38.definition: The EMS certification level at which the individual is providing patient care services for the EMS agency.

dPersonnel.39.name: Date of Personnel's Certification or Licensure for Agency
dPersonnel.39.definition: The date that the Certification/Licensure was achieved for the local EMS agency.

dDevice.01.name: Medical Device Serial Number
dDevice.01.definition: The unique manufacturer's serial number associated with a medical device.

dDevice.02.name: Medical Device Name or ID
dDevice.02.definition: The local number or configurable Name/ID of the medical device.

dDevice.04.name: Medical Device Manufacturer
dDevice.04.definition: The manufacturer of the medical device.

dDevice.05.name: Medical Device Model Number
dDevice.05.definition: The specific manufacturer's model number associated with medical device.

dDevice.06.name: Medical Device Purchase Date
dDevice.06.definition: The date the device was purchased or placed in service by the EMS agency.

dFacility.01.name: Type of Facility
dFacility.01.definition: The type of facility (healthcare or other) that the EMS agency transports patients to or from.

dFacility.03.name: Facility Location Code
dFacility.03.definition: The code of the facility as assigned by the state or the EMS agency.

dFacility.04.name: Hospital Designations
dFacility.04.definition: The designation(s) associated with the hospital (e.g., Trauma, STEMI, Peds, etc.)

dFacility.05.name: Facility National Provider Identifier
dFacility.05.definition: The facility National Provider Identifier associated with National Provider System (NPS).

dFacility.06.name: Facility Room, Suite, or Apartment
dFacility.06.definition: The number of the specific room, suite, or apartment of the facility.

dFacility.07.name: Facility Street Address
dFacility.07.definition: The address where the facility is located.

dFacility.08.name: Facility City
dFacility.08.definition: The city where the facility is located (physical address).

dFacility.09.name: Facility State
dFacility.09.definition: The state where the facility is located.

dFacility.10.name: Facility ZIP Code
dFacility.10.definition: The zip code where the facility is located.

dFacility.11.name: Facility County
dFacility.11.definition: The county where the facility is located.

dFacility.12.name: Facility Country
dFacility.12.definition: The country where the facility is located.

dFacility.14.name: Facility US National Grid Coordinates
dFacility.14.definition: The facility's US National Grid coordinates.

dCustomResults.01.name: Custom Data Element Result
dCustomResults.01.definition: The actual value or values chosen (if values listed in dCustomConfiguration.06) or result (free text, Date/Time, or number) documented for the Custom Data Element.

dCustomResults.02.name: Custom Element ID Referenced
dCustomResults.02.definition: References the CustomElementID attribute for dCustomConfiguration.CustomGroup.

dCustomResults.03.name: CorrelationID of DemographicReport Element or Group
dCustomResults.03.definition: References the CorrelationID attribute of an element or group in the DemographicReport section.
